title: D.Ai OS: a free, private operating system with AI that runs on your computer
description: D.Ai OS is a free, open-source operating system based on Debian, in eight languages. Its AI runs on your computer, not in the cloud. No ads, no telemetry, no account. Made for computers that cannot get Windows 11.

hero.title_html: The computer that does what you say and keeps it to itself
hero.lead: D.Ai OS is a free operating system based on Debian. You write or say what you want, and it sets things up, installs, finds files and answers questions. Its AI, called Diamond, runs on your computer: nothing you ask leaves it. No ads, no telemetry, no account needed.
chips: AI on the computer, not the cloud
Runs on computers from 4 GB RAM
hero.alt: The D.Ai OS desktop: a dark background with purple and turquoise waves, a floating taskbar with the diamond button, a command field, language, volume and the clock.

tour.title: A tour of the system
tour.intro: Every picture here is a real screenshot, taken automatically while D.Ai OS is tested on every change.

items.title: Ask, and get an answer on your own computer
items.text: Press the diamond or start typing in the panel. Write ? and a question, and Diamond answers. Diamond is an AI model that runs on your processor (llama.cpp), so your questions, files and voice never leave the computer. The same field opens apps, does math, finds files and runs commands.
items.alt: The D.Ai Command window over the file manager: the question "what is linux?" and Diamond's answer, marked "runs on this computer".

items.title: "Install an antivirus": a plan first, then one click
items.text: Write + and what you need. D.Ai shows exactly what will happen before anything changes: which packages, which service, a daily scan. You approve, and it is done. Every system change is recorded and can be undone.
items.alt: D.Ai Command with "+install antivirus": the plan shows the ClamAV packages, enabling the update service and a daily scan of the home folder.

items.title: Ask in plain words: "find the photos from today", "why is the computer slow?"
items.text: Write what you are looking for, the way you would say it, and the file is found by its meaning and date. Ask why something is slow or full, and D.Ai Doctor checks the computer and offers a safe fix, in Hebrew, English and six more languages.
items.alt: D.Ai Command over the installer with "find photos from today", and the result: beach.jpg in Pictures, from today.

items.title: When something breaks, it explains and offers a fix
items.text: A program crashed or a service failed? D.Ai Heal shows a notification, and opens a chat that explains what happened in plain words. The fix comes from a closed list, and it runs only when you click (Super+F1).
items.alt: The "D.Ai Help & Repair" window: "Tell me what is not working, or pick a problem I noticed", with two problems found, a failed service and an app that crashed, and a field to describe a problem.

items.title: Need a small app? Describe it
items.text: "Build me a to-do list." Diamond writes the app, tests it and fixes it until it works, and runs it in a sandbox: it cannot read your files or go online unless you allow it.
items.alt: A to-do list app called "My tasks" in Hebrew, built by D.Ai Forge, with two tasks, an add button and a delete-marked button.

items.title: Everything quick, in one place
items.text: Wi-Fi, do not disturb, battery saver, the microphone and volume. Also the computer's security score with what would improve it, problems D.Ai Heal found, and who used the camera or microphone.
items.alt: The D.Ai Quick panel: Wi-Fi, do not disturb, battery saver and mute tiles, a volume slider, "Security 85/100", "D.Ai Heal found 2 problems" and "Nothing is recording".

items.title: Mail that reads right to left
items.text: J is D.Ai's mail app. It finds your server's settings by itself, signs and encrypts mail (OpenPGP and S/MIME), cleans tracking pixels out of messages, and imports mail from Outlook (PST) and Thunderbird.
items.alt: The J mail window in Hebrew: folders on the right, a list of messages, and an open message about a meeting summary.

items.title: What is slowing the computer down, in plain words
items.text: MOM shows apps, not a list of processes: how much memory and processor each one takes, whether it runs in a sandbox and what it is recording. Diamond explains what an app is and why it is heavy, and a runaway process is stopped before it freezes the computer.
items.alt: The MOM window in Hebrew: Ruby, J, GIMP and Zoom with memory and processor use; GIMP marked as sandboxed and Zoom as recording.

items.title: A clipboard history that never keeps passwords
items.text: Super+V shows what you copied, in Hebrew and English, with search. Passwords, tokens and card numbers are recognized and never saved.
items.alt: The clipboard history window with search and two copied texts, one in Hebrew and one in English.

items.title: The boot menu, the loading screen and the login, all in D.Ai's look
items.text: From the USB stick's menu (in eight languages) through the loading screen, where an encrypted disk asks for its passphrase, to a login screen with the clock, the keyboard language and Caps Lock warning, right to left in Hebrew and Arabic.
items.alt: Four pictures: the USB boot menu with the diamond and "Start D.Ai OS", its Language submenu, the loading screen with the diamond, and the login screen with the clock and a password field.

items.title: Try it from a USB stick, then install with encryption
items.text: D.Ai OS starts from a USB stick without changing anything, so you can check Wi-Fi, sound and the printer first. The installer encrypts the whole disk, and the welcome wizard asks a few questions in your language.
items.alt: The D.Ai OS installer: steps on the side (welcome, location, keyboard, partitions, users, summary, install, finish) and the D.Ai OS diamond.

inside.title: What's inside
inside.intro: Built on Debian 13, with programs made for D.Ai. Everything below is in version 0.1, works offline and costs nothing.

groups.title: Say it, and it's done
items: D.Ai Command
one field for apps, files, math, questions (?), settings (!), installing (+) and the terminal (>).
D.Ai Tune
settings in a sentence: "lock the screen after 5 minutes", "open port 8080", "light theme". It shows a plan first, and every change can be undone.
D.Ai Find
"the PDF about the lease from last week": file search in plain words.
D.Ai Voice
dictation in Hebrew, English and more, on the computer (Whisper).
Wrong keyboard?
text typed in the wrong language is fixed with one key (Pause).

groups.title: Diamond, the AI on your computer
items: Diamond
answers, explains and summarizes. Models are downloaded once and checked with SHA-256.
D.Ai Forge
installs software from a plan you approve, and builds small apps in a sandbox.
Automations
"every morning, back up my photos": scheduled tasks that run in a sandbox.
D.Ai Code
a coding assistant for developers, also local.

groups.title: It looks after itself
items: D.Ai Doctor
"why is the computer slow?", "what fills the disk?", with safe fixes.
D.Ai Heal
when something crashes: a notification, an explanation, and a fix you approve.
Raz
checks the system before and after every update and reports what broke. Every D.Ai window also passes an accessibility check before each release.
Snapshots and Rescue
the system is saved before every update. Undo it in a sentence, or from the USB stick if the computer no longer starts.

groups.title: Privacy and security
items: From day one
disk encryption, a firewall, AppArmor and automatic security updates.
D.Ai Privacy
a red dot appears when something records or films, and a local log shows who did it and when.
D.Ai Backup
an encrypted, automatic backup to an external drive, set up in one sentence.
Ruby
the browser: Firefox ESR with tracking protection, uBlock Origin and containers, set up for privacy.
Nothing sent
no telemetry, no ads, and no account required.

groups.title: Every day
items: D.Ai Move
from Windows: documents, pictures, browser bookmarks and mail.
Themes
D.Ai Night, D.Ai Day and high contrast, in every D.Ai window, chosen in one sentence ("light theme").
The basics
screenshots (Print), night light, an on-screen keyboard, a magnifier, and most printers with no driver.
Software
Debian's packages and Flathub, plus recipes for Zoom, Steam, Office alternatives and work VPNs.

groups.title: Editions
items: Users
for everyday use.
Developers
with git, Python, build tools and D.Ai Code.
Education
for schools: organization policies, no cloud account, no tracking.
Computer sellers (OEM)
install once, and the buyer sets up their own user at first start.

groups.title: Beyond the desktop
items: D.Ai PDF

every PDF opens in a sandbox; what the file wants to do (scripts, launching programs, sending forms) is shown and never done. Pages, forms, notes, a stamped signature, real redaction and OCR, all inside the sandbox.
D.Ai VM

Windows in a window, from your own installation media and your own key: Secure Boot, TPM 2.0, a snapshot before an update; shared folder, clipboard and USB only when you turn them on. D.Ai never ships Windows.
D.Ai TV

an edition for the computer on the TV: Kodi in Hebrew, driven by the remote; your own channel list, the broadcasters' sites, night mode and a children's profile in one sentence; nothing listens on the network.
Phone and ARM (experimental)
touch mode in every D.Ai window; an arm64 image with Phosh for Linux phones, and the TV edition for ARM boxes, build and boot in CI. Not a replacement for the phone in your pocket.

groups.title: Coming from Windows
items: Focus and game mode
"focus for 25 minutes": pop-ups hidden, a warmer light, a timer; game mode gives full performance and quiet, and puts everything back when you are done.
Settings, Store and your phone
one Settings window over D.Ai Tune's catalog, every change shows its plan first and can be undone; a Store without an account; KDE Connect links your phone over the local network only.
Find inside the documents
"the file about the lease": a local index of your documents (text, Office, PDF) built when the computer is idle, never leaving it.
"Firefox does not go online"
one sentence makes an app offline: its launcher starts it in a sandbox with no network (bubblewrap, no root needed); files, display, sound and the GPU stay. Undo in one sentence too.
Live captions and a memory saver
subtitles for whatever the computer plays, read by whisper.cpp on this computer; and a memory saver for old computers: compressed swap first, Diamond on its smallest model, MOM says what is heavy.

windows.title: Have Windows 10? Here's how to switch
windows.intro: Windows 10 no longer gets free security updates. Instead of buying a new computer:
steps: Try it without installing. Write D.Ai OS to a USB stick and start the computer from it. Ask "will the Wi-Fi work?" and it checks Wi-Fi, sound, the printer and the camera before anything changes.
Back up your folder (C:\Users\your-name) to an external drive.
Bring your files over: "move my files from Windows". Documents, pictures and the desktop come across, with Chrome and Edge bookmarks and Outlook mail. Nothing is overwritten.
Install what you need: + zoom, + steam, + printer, + install word.

support.title: Support the project
support.intro: D.Ai OS is free and open source, with no ads and no subscription, and will stay that way. If you want to help it move forward, you can support it with a one-time or monthly amount through GitHub Sponsors.
what: Build and test minutes in CI: every change is built, booted in a virtual machine and checked
Test hardware: computers, a Linux tablet and phone, a TV box
Accounts and keys: the extension's signing, the update repository, certificates
A legal review, an accessibility audit and an external security review before a release
support.note: Support is a donation to an open-source project, not a purchase of a service; it promises no feature and no date. GitHub handles the payment; we never see card details.
support.thanks: Thank you. Every supporter is listed in SPONSORS.md, unless they ask otherwise.

faq.title: Questions
items: Is it really free?
Yes. It is open source under the Apache-2.0 licence, with no ads and no subscription.
Does the AI send anything to the internet?
No. The models are downloaded once and checked with SHA-256, then they run on the computer. Questions, files and voice are not sent anywhere.
How do updates work?
Debian's security updates install automatically. D.Ai updates come from a signed repository, when you choose. The system is saved before every update, so it can be undone.
What if something breaks?
Every change made in a sentence can be undone (dai-tune undo). Ask "why doesn't X work?" (D.Ai Doctor), or report it on GitHub.
Which languages are supported?
Hebrew, English, Arabic, Russian, Spanish, French, German and Portuguese: the system, the AI's commands and this website.
Who makes D.Ai OS?
Diamond Rubinny (d.Ai), as an open-source project. The code is on GitHub, and anyone can read it, check it and contribute.
